claims.quote: Our facilities management team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your facilities management team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To help move things forward, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify what you need and how Cedar Systems can support your goals.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will be happy to arrange the meeting.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific goals or outcomes are you hoping to achieve with workflow coordination and account reporting?
Are there any current challenges or inefficiencies in your facilities management processes that you would like to address?
uncertainties: The lack of a specific project owner or requirement makes it difficult to tailor the discovery meeting effectively.
It is unclear what specific needs or expectations the customer has for Cedar Systems' services.
